nodes.label: E
nodes.title:
Our daily bread.
The outer correspondence is about "your Father". The secound correspondence is about contrast between the LORD and the evil. The third correspondence is also contrast between to come (Greek{e)lqe/tw}), and not entering (Greek{mh\ ei)sene/gkh|j}). The fourth correspondence is about sentence style "as" or "like" (Greek{wj}). The central part is about "daily bread". The word translated as "daily" is Greek{e)piou/sion}. The meaning of Greek{e)piou/sion} has been controversial. From the viewpoint of the structure, the former 4 parts could be interpreted as topics about the kingdom of God, and the latter 4 parts could be also interpreted as topics about kingdoms on earth. The whole theme is salvation from the evil and conversion towards the LORD. The central part would be the pivot of those two groups. Therefore, the word Greek{a)/rton e)piou/sion} would not be literal simple "daily bread"
